theorem OArithmeticClosure.actual_theta_source_exhaustion.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (chi : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K)
  (a alpha s : ℝ) (y : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
  have F := fun T => Submodule.span ℂ (↑T ∩ Set.range (JThetaAttachment.sourceVector K));
  ∃ p,
    (∀ (T : Finset ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 mu)), ∃ (hp : (F T).HasOrthogonalProjection), p T = (F T).starProjection y) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop
          (nhds ((JThetaAttachment.thetaClosure K addHaar mu chi a alpha s).starProjection y)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun T => y - p T) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (y - (JThetaAttachment.thetaClosure K addHaar mu chi a alpha s).starProjection y)) :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] addHaar mu chi a alpha s y =>
  Exists.casesOn
    (Masullo.NestedProjection.actual_family_projection_tendsto (Set.range (JThetaAttachment.sourceVector K)) y)
    fun p h => And.casesOn h fun hp ht => Exists.intro p ⟨hp, ⟨ht, Filter.Tendsto.sub tendsto_const_nhds ht⟩⟩

  ∃ p,
